about: counter-gui model and view mutants. Killers are the examples suite (examples:counter-gui: its laws, tests and CLI cases); each rule names the law or case that kills it.

mutants.name: x-gui-dec-below-zero
mutants.rule: NeverNegative: a Dec from below the step stops at zero.

mutants.name: x-gui-step-above-100-taken
mutants.rule: BadStepIgnored: a step above 100 changes nothing.

mutants.name: x-gui-reset-forgets-the-step
mutants.rule: ResetKeepsTheStep: Reset keeps the step the user picked.

mutants.name: x-gui-minus-key-counts-up
mutants.rule: cases/play: the - key counts down (the view maps keys to signals; no law sees the view).
